qs.p: 歡迎大家來到彰化，接下來這一年請多多指教。
a: Welcome to Changhua! We're really looking forward to working with all of you this year.
Welcome to Changhua! Please give us many instructions this year.
Welcome to Changhua! This year please teach us more and more.
Welcome to Changhua! Please point out our mistakes all year.
qs.n: 「請多多指教」是客套話，不要直譯成 instructions。英文用 looking forward to working with you 表達同樣的善意。
x: We're so glad to have you here, and we can't wait to work with you this year.

qs.p: 說明會大約兩個小時，中間會休息十分鐘。
a: The orientation will run about two hours, with a ten-minute break in the middle.
The orientation is about two hours, and in the middle we will rest ten minutes.
The orientation takes around two hours; you can leave after ten minutes.
The orientation has two hours, middle will have ten minutes rest.
qs.n: 活動「進行多久」用 run / take about two hours；中場「休息」用 break，不說 rest。
x: It'll take about two hours, and we'll have a short ten-minute break halfway through.

qs.p: 有任何問題，隨時用 LINE 跟我說，不用客氣。
a: If you have any questions, just message me on LINE anytime. Don't hesitate!
Any problem, LINE me anytime, no need to be polite.
If you have questions, you must contact me on LINE immediately.
Any question you can tell me LINE, don't be polite.
qs.n: 這裡的「不用客氣」意思是「別不好意思問」，英文說 don't hesitate。no need to be polite 會讓外國人一頭霧水。
x: Feel free to LINE me anytime if anything comes up.

qs.p: 第一週主要是熟悉環境，還不用正式上課。
a: The first week is mainly for getting settled in. You won't start teaching full classes yet.
The first week is to be familiar with the environment, no need to formally go to class.
During the first week, you don't need to come to school at all.
The first week you will familiar the environment and not formal class.
qs.n: 「熟悉環境」最自然的說法是 get settled in / get to know the school。familiar 是形容詞，不能當動詞用。

qs.p: Is there a dress code I should know about?
a: 學校對服裝有沒有什麼規定，是我需要知道的？
有沒有我需要知道的服裝密碼？
我可以穿便服來上班嗎？
學校會發制服給我嗎？
qs.n: dress code＝服裝規定，不是「密碼」。口譯時要問的是「有沒有規定」，不要自己縮小成「可不可以穿便服」。

qs.p: 學校會幫你安排一位協同教學的中籍英語老師。
a: The school will pair you with a local English teacher as your co-teacher.
The school will arrange a Chinese English teacher to help you teach.
The school will give you a Chinese-speaking assistant to translate for you.
The school will arrange one cooperative teaching middle English teacher.
qs.n: 「中籍老師」不要說 Chinese teacher，外師可能理解成「中國籍」或「教中文的老師」。外師計畫的慣用說法是 local English teacher（LET）。
x: You'll be co-teaching with a local English teacher, or LET.

qs.p: 拿到居留證之後，請把正反面拍照傳給我。
a: Once you get your ARC, please send me a photo of the front and back.
After you take the ARC, please photo the front and back face to me.
Please bring your passport to me after you get the ARC.
When you have the residence card, take picture front back give me.
qs.n: ARC＝Alien Resident Certificate，外師都這樣稱呼居留證。「拍照傳給我」說 send me a photo of…。
x: When your ARC comes in, could you snap a photo of both sides and send it to me?

qs.p: 健保卡下來之前，看醫生要先自費，收據記得留著。
a: Until your NHI card arrives, you'll have to pay out of pocket at the doctor's, so be sure to keep your receipts.
Before health card comes down, see doctor self-pay, remember keep receipt.
Until your NHI card arrives, the doctor will see you for free.
Before your NHI card arrives, you are not allowed to see a doctor.
qs.n: 「自費」是 pay out of pocket；「卡下來」是 arrive / come in，不說 come down。

qs.p: 這份表格要簽全名，拼法要跟護照上一樣。
a: Please sign this form with your full name, spelled exactly as it is in your passport.
Please sign this form with your complete name, same spelling with passport.
Please write your Chinese name on this form.
Please sign your initials, the same way as in your passport.
qs.n: 「拼法跟護照一樣」：spelled exactly as it is in your passport / matching your passport。

qs.p: 勞保和健保的費用會直接從薪水扣。
a: Your labor insurance and NHI premiums will be deducted directly from your paycheck.
Labor insurance and health insurance fees will directly buckle from your salary.
The school pays all your insurance, so nothing comes out of your salary.
You need to pay labor insurance and NHI at the post office every month.
qs.n: 「從薪水扣」是 deducted from your paycheck，也可以說 comes out of your paycheck。保險的「費用」叫 premium。buckle 是「扣皮帶」的扣。

qs.p: My ARC expires in March. Do I need to start the renewal process now?
a: 我的居留證三月到期，現在需要開始辦延期了嗎？
我的居留證三月才會寄來，現在可以先辦嗎？
我三月要出國，需要先辦居留證嗎？
我的居留證三月過期了，罰款要怎麼繳？
qs.n: expire＝到期；renewal＝展延、延期。注意時態：expires in March 是「三月會到期」，還沒過期。

qs.p: 如果搬家，要在十五天內向移民署更新地址。
a: If you move, you have to update your address with the National Immigration Agency within 15 days.
If you move house, fifteen days inside go immigration change address.
If you move, the school will update your address for you automatically.
If you move, you need to tell the police station within 15 days.
qs.n: 移民署的英文是 National Immigration Agency（NIA）。「…天內」用 within 15 days。

qs.p: 這學期你們班的進度是第三課到第六課。
a: This semester, your class will cover Units 3 through 6.
This semester your class progress is lesson three to lesson six.
This semester your class only needs to finish Units 3 and 6.
This semester your class schedule is from 3 to 6 o'clock.
qs.n: 教學「進度」用 cover（教到）表達最自然；從某課到某課說 Units 3 through 6。

qs.p: 上課前十分鐘，可以跟協同老師討論一下分工。
a: You can use the ten minutes before class to go over who does what with your co-teacher.
Ten minutes before class, you can discuss division of labor with co-teacher.
Your co-teacher will teach the whole class, and you just need to observe.
Ten minutes before class you should discuss the work separating.
qs.n: 「分工」口語說 who does what，也可以說 split the roles；division of labor 太像社會學課本。

qs.p: 學生程度落差很大，可能要準備分層的活動。
a: There's a big gap in the students' levels, so you may need to prepare differentiated activities.
Students' level drop is very big, maybe need prepare layer activities.
The students are all beginners, so keep every activity very simple.
The students' levels have a big fall, so prepare layered activity.
qs.n: 「程度落差」用 gap in levels；「分層教學」的專有名詞是 differentiated instruction。

qs.p: 這週三下午有英語科教學研究會，外師也要參加。
a: There's an English department meeting on Wednesday afternoon, and FETs are expected to attend too.
This Wednesday afternoon has a teaching research meeting, foreign teacher also must join.
On Wednesday afternoon, FETs can go home early because of the meeting.
The meeting is on Wednesday; foreign teachers can choose to come or not.
qs.n: 「教學研究會」對外師說 department meeting 最好懂。「也要參加」用 are expected to attend，比 must 柔和。

qs.p: I'd love to have more say in lesson planning. Right now I mostly just read the vocabulary aloud.
a: 我很希望在備課上能多參與一些，現在我大多只是負責唸單字。
我很喜歡現在的備課方式，唸單字很輕鬆。
我想要多一點說話的時間，不想再備課了。
我希望學校多給我一些單字表。
qs.n: have more say in＝在…上有更多參與、決定權。轉達給學校時要保留他的訴求，語氣可以放委婉。

qs.p: 期末評量的題目，麻煩你在下週五前給我。
a: Could you get me the questions for the final assessment by next Friday?
Final evaluation questions trouble you give me before next Friday.
Please give me the final exam answers after next Friday.
Could you take the final exam next Friday?
qs.n: 「麻煩你…」換成 Could you…? 最自然；期限「在…之前」用 by next Friday。

qs.p: 下個月教育處的委員會來觀課。
a: Next month, a panel from the county Education Department will come to observe your class.
Next month education department committee will come to watch class.
Next month, you will go to the Education Department to observe other classes.
Next month, the Education Department will cancel your class.
qs.n: 「觀課」是 observe a class / sit in on a class；watch class 聽起來像在看熱鬧。

qs.p: 整體來說上得很好，學生參與度很高。
a: Overall, the lesson went really well. The students were very engaged.
Overall speaking, you teach very good, students' participation degree is very high.
Overall, the lesson was okay, but the students looked bored.
In general the lesson is good, students join very much.
qs.n: 「參與度高」最道地的說法是 the students were very engaged；participation degree 是中式直譯。

qs.p: 有一個小建議：指令可以再簡短一點。
a: One small suggestion: you might try keeping your instructions a bit shorter.
One small suggestion: your instructions are too long and nobody understands them.
Small suggestion: command can be more short.
One small suggestion: give more instructions next time.
qs.n: 給回饋時用 you might try… 很柔和。課堂「指令」是 instructions，不是 commands。第二個選項意思對，但太直接，會傷人。

qs.p: 你寫在黑板上的字，後排的學生不太看得到。
a: The students in the back couldn't quite see what you wrote on the board.
The words you write on blackboard, behind students can't see too much.
The students in the back row didn't want to read the board.
Your handwriting on the board is very ugly.
qs.n: not quite＝不太…，是委婉說法。「後排學生」說 the students in the back。

qs.p: Thanks for the feedback. Could you sit in again in a couple of weeks, so I can show you the changes?
a: 謝謝您的回饋。過兩週左右，可以請您再來觀課一次嗎？我想讓您看看我調整後的樣子。
謝謝您的回饋，不過兩週後我不想再被觀課。
謝謝您，兩週後可以換我去旁聽您的課嗎？
謝謝回饋，請您兩週內把修改過的教案給我。
qs.n: sit in（on a class）＝入班觀課、旁聽；a couple of weeks＝兩週左右。

qs.p: 觀課後的回饋會談大概二十分鐘，地點在英語教室。
a: The post-observation debrief will take about twenty minutes, in the English classroom.
After watching class, the feedback talking is about 20 minutes, place in English classroom.
There will be no meeting after the observation.
The feedback meeting is twenty minutes before the observation.
qs.n: 「議課、回饋會談」常用 debrief 或 post-observation conference。

qs.p: 請病假超過兩天，要附醫生證明。
a: If you take more than two days of sick leave, you'll need a doctor's note.
Sick leave over two days must attach doctor proof.
You can take as many sick days as you like without a note.
If you are sick for two days, you must come to school anyway.
qs.n: 「醫生證明」口語說 doctor's note，正式一點是 medical certificate。

qs.p: 你明天的課我已經找好代課老師了，放心休息。
a: I've already arranged a sub for your classes tomorrow, so just rest and don't worry.
Your class tomorrow I already found substitute, you can rest heart.
I couldn't find a sub, so you still need to come in tomorrow.
Tomorrow your class is canceled, so you need to make it up on Saturday.
qs.n: 代課老師是 substitute teacher，口語簡稱 sub。「放心」說 don't worry，不說 rest heart。

qs.p: 請事假要在三天前提出申請。
a: Personal leave needs to be requested at least three days in advance.
Ask for thing leave must apply three days before.
Personal leave can be requested the same morning.
You can take personal leave three times a year.
qs.n: 事假＝personal leave；「提前」用 in advance。

qs.p: 你這週六要補課，下週一可以補休一天。
a: You'll be making up classes this Saturday, so you'll get next Monday off in exchange.
This Saturday you fill class, next Monday you can fill rest one day.
This Saturday is a holiday, and next Monday is also a holiday.
You must work this Saturday, and there is no day off in return.
qs.n: 補課＝make up classes；補休＝get a day off in exchange / a comp day。中文的「補」英文沒有一個字通用。

qs.p: I'm feeling a bit under the weather. Is it okay if I head home after fourth period?
a: 我身體有點不舒服，第四節課後可以先回家嗎？
天氣不好，第四節課後可以提早下班嗎？
我想第四節課去外面走走。
我感冒好了，第四節課後可以回來上班。
qs.n: under the weather 是「身體不舒服」，跟天氣無關，是經典陷阱。head home＝回家。

qs.p: 請假單填好之後，要給主任和校長簽名。
a: Once you've filled out the leave form, it needs to be signed by the director and the principal.
After leave paper write good, give director and principal sign name.
You can sign the leave form yourself; no one else needs to see it.
After filling in the leave form, give it to the students.
qs.n: 「填好」用 fill out；「主任」是 director，指教務、學務等處室主任。

qs.p: 縣政府今晚會宣布明天要不要停班停課。
a: The county government will announce tonight whether work and classes are canceled tomorrow.
County government tonight will announce tomorrow stop work stop class or not.
The county government has already announced that tomorrow is a normal day.
The school will decide tomorrow morning whether there is a typhoon.
qs.n: 停班停課＝work and classes are canceled，外師口語也說 typhoon day。「要不要」用 whether。

qs.p: 颱風天請待在家裡，不要去海邊。
a: Please stay indoors during the typhoon and keep away from the coast.
Typhoon day please stay home, don't go to sea side.
During the typhoon, the beach is the safest place to go.
On the typhoon day, please come to school to help.
qs.n: 「海邊」可說 the coast / the beach；keep away from 比 don't go to 更有提醒安全的語氣。

qs.p: 地震的時候先趴下、掩護、穩住，不要往外跑。
a: During an earthquake: drop, cover, and hold on. Don't run outside.
Earthquake time first lie down, cover, stable, don't run outside.
During an earthquake, run outside as fast as you can.
During an earthquake, stand in a doorway and wait.
qs.n: 防震標準口訣的英文就是 Drop, Cover, and Hold On，外師在母國多半學過。

qs.p: 有學生在操場跌倒，已經送到健康中心了。
a: A student fell on the field and has been taken to the nurse's office.
Student fall down on playground, already send to health center.
A student fell on the field and walked home alone.
A student fell on the field; please take them to the hospital yourself.
qs.n: 學校的「健康中心」對美國人說 nurse's office。health center 會被理解成社區醫療中心。

qs.p: I think I need to see a doctor. Could someone come with me to help translate?
a: 我覺得我需要看醫生，可以請人陪我去，幫忙翻譯嗎？
我覺得我需要去當醫生的翻譯。
我想請醫生來學校幫我看病。
我不需要看醫生，但需要有人幫我翻譯文件。
qs.n: see a doctor＝看醫生；come with me＝陪我去。

qs.p: 如果需要叫救護車，請打一一九。
a: If you need an ambulance, call 119.
If you need an ambulance, call 110.
If need call ambulance, beat 119.
If you need an ambulance, call 911.
qs.n: 台灣救護車、消防是 119，警察是 110。美國人直覺會打 911，要特別提醒。

qs.p: 校長不是在怪你，只是希望下次能先說一聲。
a: The principal isn't blaming you. They'd just appreciate a heads-up next time.
Principal's meaning is not blame you, only hope next time first tell one sound.
The principal is very angry, so don't do it again.
The principal doesn't mind, so you can do whatever you like.
qs.n: 「先說一聲」就是 give someone a heads-up，是外師最常用的詞之一。

qs.p: 校長說「這件事我們再研究看看」，聽口氣其實是委婉拒絕。哪一句轉述最貼切？
a: I'm afraid that might be difficult, but we'll keep it in mind.
We will research this matter and see.
Yes, we will definitely do it.
No. Don't ask again.
qs.n: 口譯要譯「意思」，不只譯字面。直譯成 research 的話，外師會以為還有機會而一直等。把委婉拒絕的訊號也譯出來，才是幫雙方的忙。

qs.p: 不好意思，這是我們這邊溝通不清楚。
a: Sorry, that was a miscommunication on our end.
Not good meaning, this is our side communicate not clear.
Sorry, but you didn't listen carefully.
Sorry, you should learn more Chinese.
qs.n: on our end＝我們這邊；miscommunication 一個字就是「溝通不清楚」。

qs.p: 我理解你的感受，我會把你的意見轉達給學校。
a: I understand how you feel, and I'll pass your concerns on to the school.
I understand your feeling, I will transfer your opinion to school.
I understand, but the school won't change anything.
I don't understand why you feel that way.
qs.n: 「轉達」用 pass on；「意見」若是不滿或擔心，用 concerns 更貼切。

qs.p: Honestly, I feel like I'm out of the loop whenever the schedule changes.
a: 老實說，每次課表有變動，我都覺得沒有人通知我。
老實說，我覺得課表太滿，想要多一點空堂。
我覺得自己被排除在環狀路線外面。
老實說，我不喜歡改課表。
qs.n: out of the loop＝不知情、沒被通知；反義是 keep me in the loop（隨時讓我知道）。

qs.p: 這次的誤會，大家都有責任，我們一起想辦法改進。
a: We all played a part in this misunderstanding. Let's work together to make things better.
This time misunderstanding, everybody has responsibility, we together think method improve.
This misunderstanding is entirely your fault.
Nobody is responsible, so let's just forget it.
qs.n: played a part in＝都有份。用 Let's work together… 收尾，表達一起面對。

qs.p: 家長會想知道孩子在英文課的表現。
a: Parents will want to know how their kids are doing in English class.
Parents will want to know child's English class performance situation.
Parents want you to give their children higher grades.
Parents will come to watch you teach every day.
qs.n: 「表現如何」最自然的說法是 how they're doing。

qs.p: 校慶當天，可以請外師帶一個英語闖關攤位嗎？
a: Would you be willing to run an English game booth on our school anniversary day?
School celebration day, foreign teacher can bring one English break-through-level booth?
On anniversary day, could you sell food at a booth?
On anniversary day, you don't need to come to school.
qs.n: 「帶」攤位用 run a booth；闖關活動可說 game booth / game station。Would you be willing to… 是客氣的請求。

qs.p: 畢業典禮上，想請你用英文說一段祝福的話。
a: We'd love for you to say a few words of congratulations in English at the graduation ceremony.
Graduation ceremony please you use English say one paragraph bless words.
At graduation, please sing an English song by yourself.
At graduation, please translate the principal's speech.
qs.n: 「說幾句話」英文是 say a few words；致詞時的「祝福」用 congratulations / best wishes。

qs.p: 有家長在 LINE 群組問你的教學方式，我先幫你回了。
a: A parent asked about your teaching approach in the LINE group, so I went ahead and replied for you.
Have parent in LINE group ask your teaching method, I first help you return.
A parent complained to the police about your teaching.
A parent wants to join your LINE group to learn English.
qs.n: 「我先幫你回了」：I went ahead and replied。went ahead and… 表示「沒等你就先做了」。

qs.p: Some parents seem worried that playing games means the kids aren't really learning.
a: 有些家長好像擔心，上課玩遊戲就代表孩子沒有真的在學。
有些家長擔心孩子在家打太多電動。
有些家長希望英文課多玩一點遊戲。
家長很擔心孩子學不會遊戲規則。
qs.n: seem worried＝好像在擔心；口譯時要保留「好像」，因為外師只是推測，沒有家長正式提出。

qs.p: 謝謝你這學期的付出，孩子們都很喜歡你。
a: Thank you for everything you've done this semester. The kids absolutely love you.
Thank you this semester's pay out, children all like you very much.
Thank you for paying for the students this semester.
Thanks, but the kids want a new teacher next semester.
qs.n: 「付出」不是 pay。說 thank you for everything you've done / for all your hard work。
